definition.share: first-breach split of the two-branch union (ADR-0057), each alternative with its own pipe breach times
definition.conditioning: 2016 update at KP 57.4 and 62.0, none at KP 58.8 and 60.0 (ADR-0056); steady_state is before any update (thesis Table 7.4)

labels.adopted: adopted (matrix, adopted conductivity, no foreland credit)

labels.bulk_k_aq_regional_upper: bulk d70 with the regional upper conductivity
labels.bulk_k_aq_field_geomean: bulk d70 with the six-test field geometric mean
labels.bulk_k_aq_field_toe: bulk d70 with the landside-toe field test
labels.seepage_tail_0.85: seepage length bounded at 0.85 of its mean
labels.steady_state: steady-state criterion, same head and gate (instantaneous growth)
labels.prior_baseline: adopted inputs before any 2016 update (uniformity baseline)
labels.cu_cap: uniformity term at its tested maximum (prior)
labels.cu_sand: uniformity term extrapolated to the sand fraction (prior)
labels.cu_matrix: uniformity term extrapolated to the matrix with fines (prior)
